name: WifiMap 0.2.0 Preview
body:
First public preview of WifiMap for Windows and Android.

## Included
- Separate native Windows and Android applications for mapping Wi-Fi observations onto a floor plan.
- PNG/JPEG floor-plan import, scale calibration, walls, router markers and editable measurement points.
- Survey sessions, supported-area signal estimates, before/after comparison and self-contained SVG reports.
- A shared .wifimap project format that preserves Windows and Android observations, timestamps and SSID provenance.
- English, Russian, French, German, Spanish and Italian, plus light/dark themes and reduced motion.
- Manual update checking, optional startup checks and user-initiated update installation paths.

## Downloads
- **WifiMap-v0.2.0.exe**: portable Windows x64 application. No installer is required.
- **WifiMap-v0.2.0-debug.apk**: development-signed Android application, requiring Android 8.0 (API 26) or later. This uses the separate com.siarheisinelnikau.wifimap.debug package and is not a production-signed Android release.
- SHA-256 sidecars and dependency notices accompany the applications. Both applications also include license notices.

## Verified
- Windows formatting, strict Clippy checks, 30 automated tests and release packaging passed on GitHub Actions.
- Android Gradle compilation, 11 domain tests, lint, APK packaging and static signature/resource checks passed on GitHub Actions.
- Shared project round trips preserve the fixture, and the two heatmap implementations agree within 0.001 dBm on the interoperability fixture.
- The downloadable Windows PE and Android APK were inspected without starting the applications.

## Preview limits
- The interface, idle/hidden rendering load, real Wi-Fi measurements and update installation have not been exercised on hardware. This preview is for evaluation.
- Android scans run in the foreground and depend on system permissions, location/Wi-Fi availability and platform scan throttling.
- Android does not supply a driver-quality percentage, noise or SNR in these measurements; unavailable values remain absent.
- The Android APK is a debug build. Keep its signing identity for subsequent development updates; an APK signed with another key cannot update it in place. Production Android signing remains separate.
- This preview is excluded from stable-channel automatic update offers.

Source: https://github.com/siarheisinelnikau/wifi-map/tree/0c8c9d8f92ad8d14624bb617cb4aef9dbc0574d5
